question: Which of the following plutonic rocks is usually black or dark green in colour and is mainly composed of plagioclase and augite minerals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gabbro**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gabbro **is a plutonic rock that is typically black or dark green in color** and is mainly composed of plagioclase and augite minerals: 
 
• Gabbro** is made up of calcium-rich plagioclase feldspar, pyroxenes, and iron oxides**. It also contains trace amounts of olivine. 
 
• Gabbro's colour ranges from black to very dark green due to its mineral composition. 
 
• Gabbro **is a coarse-grained rock. **
 
• Gabbro** is used in construction projects**, such as for crushed stone base materials, polished stone countertops, and floor tiles. 
 
• Gabbro is the **most common rock in the ocean's deep crust.** It can also be found in many ophiolites. 
 
• Gabbro is the plutonic equivalent of basalt. Basalt is a mafic rock, meaning it's rich in iron and magnesium, but poor in silica

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dolomite:**

 
 
• Dolomite is a **type of sedimentary rock composed primarily of the mineral dolomite (CaMg(CO₃)₂).**
 
• It is chemically similar to limestone but contains magnesium as well as calcium.
 
 
 
• ** Zeolites:**
 
 
• Zeolites **are a group of minerals that are characterized by their ability to absorb and release water and other molecules. **
 
• They are aluminosilicates (made up of aluminum, silicon, and oxygen) and have a unique crystalline structure that forms cavities and channels.
 
 
 
• **Quartzite:**
 
 
• Quartzite is a** metamorphic rock formed from the metamorphism of sandstone**, specifically when sandstone undergoes heat and pressure, transforming it into a denser, harder rock.
